classification_reason: The capture was filed verbatim into the matching stage's working note through a receipted gateway write after explicit approval, and its connections were reported; but building the envelope required reading implementation code for the intent hash, the documented routing destinations have no capability, and the diagnostics then mislabelled the write as ambiguous.

consumer.goal: File the friend's Postgres-deadlock message (eval-drop/A09.md) where it belongs and tell the learner what it connects to.
consumer.first_action: Read eval-drop/A09.md and its drop metadata (inbox-capture, arrives 2026-09-22), then read WORKFLOWS §2/§3/§8/§15/§21 for inbox routing.
commands: read PLAN-CREATION-SOP ~490-520; grep envelope in docs
impl_files_read: tools/learning_os/contracts/gateway.py (intent_sha256 / intent_subject — the approval subject hash is not specified in any document)
confusions: WORKFLOWS §21 routes 'temporary material tied to an active effort' to the workspace's scratch/, but no capability writes workspace scratch: path.note.write requires a learning-path id and stage (the world has 0 learning paths). There is also no capability that creates an ordinary durable synthesis note — only note.analysis.save (source analyses) and atlas.question.save (questions).
stage.note.write is described as 'compatibility capability only', yet OPERATOR.md says stage-specific learning belongs in the stage note; it was the only governed write that fits.

The approval subject is 'intent_sha256(envelope)', but no document defines the function; the UNCONFIRMED error ('approval subject does not match the current capability intent') gives no expected value.

Which artifacts expected_revisions must list is undocumented per capability; the INVALID_REQUEST error named them precisely (missing unit-os-l07, unexpected study-map-os-l07), which made the retry easy.

After success, `los operations` listed the write as AMBIGUOUS / needs_attention — caused by the container's TRACEPARENT being adopted as every request's trace (diagnosed in S05; F-s03-diag-ambiguous-01).
corrective_steps: Read the intent-hash implementation and reproduced it in a 10-line helper (my scratchpad mkenv.py).
Corrected expected_revisions from the error message.
From S05 on, used a fresh idempotency key for every corrected attempt.
questions_asked_to_learner: Proposed: append the message verbatim, under a short provenance header plus a 'Connects to' line, to the working note of stage-os-l07-01-deadlock (unit-os-l07) via stage.note.write — approve? → scripted reply: 'Yes, apply exactly what you showed me.'
consumer.outcome: The message now sits, verbatim with a provenance header, in the working note of the OS L07 deadlock stage (the stage the oral question belongs to). The learner is told it connects to note-deadlock-four-conditions (lock order breaks circular wait), note-two-phase-locking-deadlocks (Postgres aborting a victim), and the collected oral question 'which condition would you break in practice'. Validation 0 errors, no new warning signature; nothing committed in the world repository (not requested).

internal.transaction_behavior: Attempt 1 refused UNCONFIRMED (approval hash), attempt 2 refused INVALID_REQUEST (expected_revisions), both before any write. Attempt 3 committed atomically: one working-note write (sha256 e3b0…→34f3…, created: false), unit-os-l07 revision 0→1, snapshot 82bcffb7…→411721b3…, receipt with authority grant and intent hash.
internal.approval_behavior: Envelope approval kind operator-approval bound to intent_sha256 of {schema_version, capability, channel, expected_snapshot, expected_revisions, payload}; request_id and idempotency_key are excluded from the subject. The learner's approval was given in conversation before the envelope was built.
internal.projection_activity: snapshot_after reported by the result; `los generate` republished manifest.json; `inspect study-map-os-l07` showed the new notes_text but notes_updated '2026-09-02' (the date of the last commit touching the empty file, not the write).
internal.persistence_activity: Receipt plus two new ledgers (operations/transactions/idempotency.yaml, revisions.yaml) created untracked; operations/diagnostics/traces.jsonl appended.
internal.derived_changes: 1 derived file added, 2 modified (manifest and views).
warnings_errors: UNCONFIRMED: approval subject does not match the current capability intent
INVALID_REQUEST: expected_revisions must cover exactly every transaction artifact (missing=['unit-os-l07'], unexpected=['study-map-os-l07'])
`los operations`: canonical_outcome AMBIGUOUS, needs_attention true for the committed request

friction.description: The approval subject hash (intent_sha256) is required for every agent write but specified nowhere in the docs; I had to read tools/learning_os/contracts/gateway.py.

The documented inbox-routing destinations (workspace scratch/, a new durable synthesis note) have no gateway capability; only stage-owned notes, the inbox itself and the Garden are writable for a free-form capture.
friction.cost: ~6 tool calls reading capabilities and docs

friction.description: stage.note.write is 'compatibility capability only' (capabilities.yaml, OPERATOR) while OPERATOR also says stage-specific learning belongs in its stage note and no newer stage-note capability exists.
UNCONFIRMED gives no hint of how the intent hash is formed; by contrast INVALID_REQUEST on revisions named the exact artifacts.

After a clean commit, `los operations` flags the request AMBIGUOUS / needs_attention / BLOCKED; a user reading it would think the write may not have happened. Root cause found in S05: the container's inherited TRACEPARENT makes every los call share one trace/span id (see F-s03-diag-ambiguous-01).

change_applied.approval: Learner approved the exact proposed text and destination (scripted reply 'Yes, apply exactly what you showed me.'); envelope approval kind operator-approval.

scenario_record.original_capture_file: eval-drop/A09.md left untouched (outside the installation); not first captured into work/inbox/.

uncertainties: Whether a friend's anecdote should instead become (part of) a durable note is a judgement call; with no note-creation capability and the stage not yet started, the stage note was the least destructive governed home.
The world repository was left with uncommitted changes (no commit was requested).
